title: Formal exact projection mate for specified shift and unit data
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category] with coherent integer shifts. On each category let $\otimes$ be an additive bifunctor exact in either input, with coherent shift comparisons in each input, natural also in maps of the fixed input. Fix objects $\mathbf1_{\mathcal C},\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}$ and natural right action isomorphisms $\rho_X:X\otimes\mathbf1\xrightarrow{\sim}X$. Let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be exact functors, with a specified adjunction $L\dashv R$, unit $\eta$, counit $\varepsilon$, triangle identities, and unit and counit compatible with these shift comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection, lem-weil-pbc-commshift-nattrans-comp-whisker]. Suppose there is a natural isomorphism $\mu_{M,N}:L(M\otimes N)\xrightarrow{\sim}LM\otimes LN$ commuting with the composite shift comparisons in either input, and an isomorphism $u:L\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}$ such that $\rho_{LM}(1\otimes u)\mu_{M,\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=L\rho_M$ for every $M$.
For $E\in\mathcal D$, define $F_E(P)=RE\otimes P$, $H_E(P)=E\otimes LP$, $G_E=RH_E$, and
$$\beta_{E,P}=(\varepsilon_E\otimes1)\mu_{RE,P},\qquad \alpha_{E,P}=R(\beta_{E,P})\eta_{F_E(P)}.$$
Then $F_E,G_E$ are exact for the induced composite comparisons, and $\alpha$ is natural in both $E,P$. For every integer $n$, their induced shifts obey
$$s_{G_E,n}\alpha_{E,P[n]}=\alpha_{E,P}[n]s_{F_E,n}.$$
For a distinguished triangle with connecting arrow $w:P_3\to P_1[1]$, its image under $\alpha_E$ is a morphism of distinguished triangles [def-weil-pbc-triangles-with-shift], including the square $\alpha_{E,P_1}[1]s_{F_E,1}F_E(w)=s_{G_E,1}G_E(w)\alpha_{E,P_3}$. Finally the precise right-unit equation is
$$R\bigl(\rho_E(1_E\otimes u)\bigr)\alpha_{E,\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=\rho_{RE}.$$
This statement constructs only a transformation from already specified exact tensor, adjunction, shift and unit data; it does not construct those data from ringed sites and does not assert that $\alpha$ is invertible.
